summary: Tested Fantasy AI Coach (Claude Sonnet 4.6 via Emergent LLM key). Backend POST /api/fantasy/coach returns 200 with valid invariants across 3+ runs (xi=11 unique ids from pool, sum credits<=100, captain/vice in xi and distinct, non-empty rationale). At least one call returned source='ai' with a substantive rationale mentioning players/strategy. Frontend AI Coach button auto-fills XI (11/11), sets C/VC, shows rationale banner, enables Lock, deducts 100 coins and opens Leaderboard. Manual flow regression also passes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: LlmChat client is instantiated on every request; consider reuse or timeout guard to avoid slow requests hanging the endpoint. Current fallback covers this safely.
_build_from_ranking has O(n^2) 'p not in ordered' & 'q not in chosen' with Player objects; fine for 16 players but could bite if pool grows. Consider using id sets.

TeamBuilder.jsx: axios call to /api/fantasy/coach lacks explicit timeout; on slow AI calls user sees generic 'AI Coach unavailable' via toast which is acceptable. Consider adding a longer axios timeout (e.g., 45s).
seed_data_creation: None. Uses in-memory PLAYERS from frontend and backend echoes pool.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test lives at /app/backend/tests/test_fantasy_coach.py. Rerun via pytest. AI endpoint takes ~5-10s per call; combined tests ~25s. In-memory wallet resets on refresh so run frontend flow in single session.
